operation.summary: Real server identity and discovery metadata
operation.description: Unauthenticated by default. Real, per-client remote-access gating (Config > Remote Access) can make this respond 404 for a given X-Hydra-Client caller instead of exposing whether a server exists at all at that address.

parameters.name: X-Hydra-Client
parameters.description: Identifies which real client is asking (e.g. suite, android, ios), so the per-client remote-access gate in Config can allow/deny it independently of the others.

200.description: Real server identity, mirroring the published ServerDiscovery contract (contracts/json-schema/v1/server-discovery.schema.json).

404.description: Remote access is disabled for this X-Hydra-Client caller - deliberately indistinguishable from 'no server running here' to a scanning client. Empty body.
